points.text: All Quotations: the Allianz quotation (with the Allianz logo) can be selected and Add-ons opens for Allianz
Confirmation: insurer Allianz, with the premium from the Add-ons page (amounts recorded)
Payment page shows the same four tiles as for a Lonpac purchase: Credit or Debit Card, FPX Online banking, SPayLater, PayLater by Grab (observed)
FPX payment approved (00): Success page 'Thank you for your purchase!' with Receipt No., Purchase Date, Payment Method 'Online Banking - RHB Bank' (observed) and a [Receipt] download
Receipt Total Premium = the total on the Confirmation page

CIBO > Transaction Management row: Ins. Co. Allianz with agency badge Serba Sentral, Payment Paid, Transaction Status "Insurance created"; Payment Mode the same as a Lonpac FPX payment on /ia/ (today bare "Fiuu"; the SA format "Fiuu | Online Banking – FPX-<Bank Name>" is QA-Issue EAINT-12566, On Hold: not a 12406 failure)

CIBO Transaction Details: Cover Note No and Policy No filled (not "-"); Payment Ref ID with 'SFX' like a Lonpac FPX payment (e.g. LON<yyyymmdd>SFX<nnnn>), with Allianz's own insurer code (code recorded, Q30)
e-Certificate and Receipt buttons shown; e-Certificate opens a document for this vehicle plate
